claims.claim: Homeowners who compare several carpentry businesses before requesting a quote may drop the website early if it gives no indication of price ranges; no retrieved website, business or market evidence establishes how such comparisons currently go for Example Handwerk GmbH.

Private homeowners who compare craftsmen online find on this website the trust signals their decision weighs: every request is redirected to HTTPS with a valid certificate chain, and the owner's master craftsman title and the Handwerkskammer Berlin membership are publicly verifiable, so the site's trust foundation matches the business's predominantly private customer type.

The targeted pass found the website presenting Brandenburg-wide delivery and installation of custom furniture, while the business context places the service area at Berlin and the surrounding municipalities with reference projects no farther than Potsdam; which statement describes the current service area could not be established.

conflict.description: The website's Brandenburg-wide service statement contradicts the publicly evidenced Berlin-and-surroundings service area. Neither source is dated more recently than the other, so the diagnosis leaves the service area open instead of choosing a side.
